text.autoconfig.worldmirror.title: World Mirror Settings
text.autoconfig.worldmirror.option.defau:
Where downloaded worlds are saved.
DOWNLOADED: game-dir/downloaded_worlds
SAVES: game-dir/saves/<name>
text.autoconfig.worldmirror.option.syncI: How often (in seconds) the periodic sync fires while downloading is active.
text.autoconfig.worldmirror.option.pipel: Applied the next time downloading starts. Stable Periodic is the hardened default; Experimental Adaptive reacts to changes with bounded latency.
text.autoconfig.worldmirror.option.defau:
How to handle conflicts when a local chunk already exists.
OVERWRITE: Replace local chunk with server version.
IGNORE: Keep local chunk.
MANUAL: Queue for manual decision (falls back to Ignore).
text.autoconfig.worldmirror.option.cache: Maximum number of chunks kept in memory. Set to 0 to disable this limit.
Chunks farther than this radius from the player are evicted. Set to 0 to disable.
Maximum age of a cached chunk before eviction. Set to 0 to disable.
If enabled, a chunk is removed from memory immediately after being written to disk.
text.autoconfig.worldmirror.option.perfo: Maximum main-thread time normally spent serializing queued chunks each tick.
Experimental mode starts a write immediately when this many dirty chunks are waiting.
Longest experimental mode waits before making dirty revisions durable.
Bound on coalesced event hints waiting for main-thread capture. Unloading chunks still receive a final capture.
Every 30 seconds, log pipeline, heap and timing counters plus unusually slow region writes. Leave off normally.
With performance diagnostics enabled, report region stages slower than this threshold.
text.autoconfig.worldmirror.option.chunk: When the map cell size is at or below this value, hide the per-chunk grid. Low zoom still uses cheap 16/4-chunk guide lines.
Background style used by the chunk map.
If Xaero's World Map is installed, draw World Mirror chunk status directly on its fullscreen world map.

How the Xaero overlay mixin is applied. EXACT_ONLY preserves draw order for verified Xaero versions. TAIL_FALLBACK avoids crashes on unknown versions but may draw above Xaero map UI elements. Changing this after Xaero's map class has loaded requires a restart.
How often the Xaero World Map overlay reloads chunk status from disk in the background.
Maximum number of screen cells to draw for the Xaero overlay. Lower values improve performance at very low zoom.
text.autoconfig.worldmirror.option.lifec:
Download state when the player joins (or re-joins) a world or server.
START: begin downloading automatically.
STOP: stop downloading (default).
KEEP: leave state unchanged.

Download state when the player moves to a different dimension (e.g. Overworld → Nether).
START: begin downloading automatically.
STOP: stop downloading.
KEEP: leave state unchanged (default).

Download state when the player is sent to a different world on the same server (e.g. Multiverse plugin).
START: begin downloading automatically.
STOP: stop downloading (default).
KEEP: leave state unchanged.
Capture loaded chunks around the player before each export to reduce missed recent changes.
Capture loaded chunks around the player once when download stops.
Write all currently cached chunks once when download stops. If stop capture is enabled, nearby chunks are captured first.
